description: Use before putting any token amount into a transaction. "5 USDC" is 5,000,000 base units; getting decimals wrong sends 1,000x too much or too little. Converts between human amounts and base units using the token's real on-chain decimals. Inputs: mint: The token, or "SOL" for native SOL (9 decimals). amount: The amount to convert, as a string, e.g. "5" or "0.25". direction (optional): to_base_units turns 5 into 5000000 (for transactions); to_ui turns base units back into a readable amount. Default to_base_units. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/convert_amount.
name: convert_amount
